recent.text: The Nuggets steal a win, their best of the young season, by erasing a 17-point deficit to beat the Celtics 105-101. They’re 8-5. Nikola Jokic 24-8-9 Jamal Murray 21-7-2, 4 steals, 2 blocks Aaron Gordon 13-8-2 DeMar DeRozan scores 13 of his 18 in the fourth quarter.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: The Nuggets are attempting their 11th and 12th free throws of the fourth quarter right now. DeMar DeRozan’s foul-drawing ability early in the quarter has had a massive ripple effect.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Nuggets trail 61-49 at halftime to the Celtics. Jayson Tatum has 20. Boston is 9/25 from 3, Denver 5/18. Nikola Jokic with 12-4-5, Jamal Murray with 10-3-1-1-1. Better gang rebounding effort from Denver so far but not enough.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Successful challenge. Jump ball.
recent.author: Vinny Benedetto
recent.quoted_text: Christian Braun needs a second to recover after getting fouled on a dunk attempt. Boston uses that time to eventually challenge the call. Think they might be successful, too. Boston up 12 with 25.4 seconds left.

recent.text: Spencer Jones has 2 turnovers just for having back of his foot out of bounds on the sideline. Nuggets going w/ a Tyus Jones-Cam Johnson-Spencer Jones-Trevon Brazile-Bagley second unit (no DeRozan, who had longer run in 1Q), but still an 8-2 run for Boston and an Adelman timeout.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray played the full first quarter. The Nuggets trail 30-24 to Boston.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: David Adelman loses his challenge in the first quarter trying to reverse a Trevon Brazile offensive foul.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Jayson Tatum has 10 early points and Boston leads 15-8. Nuggets are trying to get Aaron Gordon the ball in advantageous spots to attack, but as a whole they’re struggling to score early.
